tasks.short: Compile, administer and grade cultural-studies examinations

steps.what: Compile the actual examination from course objectives, approved items and teacher-written questions
inputs: Teacher's actual new questions and answer criteria
outputs: Complete draft examination and marking criteria

steps.what: Check the complete final examination, answer key, essay criteria and student audience
inputs: Complete draft examination and marking criteria
outputs: Checked final examination and release settings

steps.what: Publish the exact checked examination to the actual course audience
inputs: Exact examination and settings checked in s2
outputs: Released examination

steps.what: Administer the actual examination and obtain students' actual responses
inputs: Actual students and agreed examination arrangements
outputs: Actual examination responses and administration issues

steps.what: Score only the actual closed-response items against the checked exact answer key
inputs: Actual digital closed responses from s4
Exact answer key checked in s2
outputs: Draft closed-item scores and invalid responses

steps.what: Evaluate and grade the actual essays and open responses using the course's criteria
outputs: Teacher's actual open-response grades and feedback

steps.what: Resolve invalid responses and check the complete grade set and actual feedback against the scripts
outputs: Complete checked final grade set

steps.what: Stage the checked LMS grades into the separate student registry using exact course and student identifiers
outputs: Staged registry grade entries and unmatched identifiers

steps.what: Check the complete final registry entries, identities and grade values against the final LMS grade set
inputs: Staged registry entries and unmatched identifiers
outputs: Exact final checked registry grade batch

steps.what: Commit the exact checked grade batch in the student registry
inputs: Exact registry batch checked in s9
outputs: Recorded final examination results

tasks.design: Configure native {LMS} item reuse and exact closed-item scoring, with an explicit grade import into the separate {OPS_SYSTEM} registry. The teacher writes new questions, administers the examination, grades open work and checks each complete final examination or registry batch before its separate release or commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated item assembly, exact closed-item marking and registry rekeying add handling to examinations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native item banks, deterministic answer-key scoring and registry import mappings can handle those exact operations.
tasks.still_hard: Interpretive essays, fairness, invalid responses and final grade decisions remain the appointed teacher's work.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher judges students' cultural and historical reasoning against actual criteria.

ambition.what: Reduce exact handling in existing examination work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native item banks, exact answer-key scoring and explicit LMS-to-registry mappings can remove repeated handling while people grade open work.

assumptions: Unmeasured mixed examination episode with actual registry rekeying. Closed-item work is deliberately small; shares come from the episode's work, not the prompt prior. An essay-only examination has no closed-score saving.

s1 counts actual teacher question authorship and assembly; s4 counts administration and capture of actual digital responses. No free paper transcription, complete new exam or model-generated student response is assumed.

s5 scores exact closed responses only; s6 grades open work manually and s7 checks all actual grades and feedback. s8 explicitly replaces separate-registry rekeying; s9 retains complete final imported-batch checking. Unmatched identifiers stop for manual resolution.
Existing equivalent item assembly, automatic marking and registry synchronization are baseline and earn no new saving. Native tools come first; no predictive grading or proctoring model is proposed.
Both release and commit are separate gated immediate actions and earn no saving. Changes void the corresponding final-version gate. Gross 21 minus 4 upkeep gives 17 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Actual closed/open item mix and registry workflow
research_questions: Which exact marking and registry entry work remains manual?

already_counted.description: Retained examination assembly, final examination check, complete grade checking and registry verification

incremental.description: Maintain item keys and registry mappings and test changed grading rules and identifiers

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete examination and audience checked in s2; edits require renewed checking
Exact complete registry grade batch checked in s9; changed grades or identifiers require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 6 assembly plus 5 closed marking plus 10 registry rekeying = 21 gross, minus 4 upkeep = 17 net. Existing equivalent automation reduces each corresponding benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep current through literature, colleagues and conferences

steps.what: Find current literature and conference material relevant to the teacher's actual cultural-studies field
inputs: OTHER: scholarly catalogue and reference manager
outputs: Located current sources and relevant sessions

steps.what: Read and critically assess the actual current literature
outputs: Teacher's understanding of actual developments and source limitations

steps.what: Talk with colleagues about actual developments and disagreements in the field
outputs: Actual academic exchange and clarified disagreements

steps.what: Participate in actual professional conference sessions and discussion
outputs: Actual professional learning and exchange

tasks.design: Configure saved searches in {OTHER} for actual current literature and use the existing conference program in {DOCS}. Retain critical reading, colleague conversations and conference participation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly searching the same catalogues adds handling before academic learning.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved searches can reuse actual topic filters.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding contested scholarship and taking part in the field require actual reading and discussion.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher assesses scholarly arguments in their historical and cultural context.

ambition.what: Reduce retrieval around existing professional learning.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: saved catalogue searches can reduce repeated retrieval without replacing critical reading and professional participation.

assumptions: Unmeasured current-awareness episode; shares are independent of the prompt prior and do not represent every academic's annual reading and conference mix.

Scholars and conference organizers supply the actual material. s1 counts finding and checking relevance; s2-s4 count actual learning and exchange. No generated literature or source claims are accepted.
No separate learning report, post-conversation record or new conference booking is established here. No meeting setup is charged per conversation. Existing saved searches earn no extra benefit.
Gross 6 minus 1 upkeep gives 5 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Actual search effort and current saved searches

already_counted.description: Retained retrieval and actual critical reading

incremental.description: Maintain actual topic filters and review search coverage

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 20 times 30% = 6 gross, minus 1 upkeep = 5 net. Reading, conversation and conference time are fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan, evaluate and revise cultural-studies curricula

steps.what: Collect and verify actual course evaluations, curriculum requirements and existing teaching materials
inputs: Actual student evaluations and course records
outputs: Checked curriculum revision evidence

steps.what: Evaluate actual content, representation, learning sequence and instructional methods
outputs: Teacher's actual revision decisions and reasons

steps.what: Plan the actual revised curriculum, course content, materials and methods of instruction
outputs: Authored revised structure and concrete teaching changes

steps.what: Assemble the actual chosen course fields and approved material blocks in the revision template
inputs: Exact approved material blocks and actual course fields
outputs: Staged revised course document

steps.what: Write and edit explanatory course wording from the teacher's actual revision decisions
inputs: Actual authored teaching changes and reasons
outputs: Complete revised draft curriculum document

loop.purpose: Draft explanatory wording for actual curriculum changes
loop.input: Teacher-authored changes, reasons and approved course blocks
loop.output: Draft explanatory prose tied to actual decisions
loop.check: Teacher compares wording with actual decisions and course constraints
loop.stop: Unsupported content, new commitments or missing facts require manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanations need semantic wording beyond exact field insertion

steps.what: Check the complete final revised curriculum, materials, learning sequence and actual approval status
inputs: Original evidence and actual teaching decisions
outputs: Complete checked final working curriculum document

steps.what: Save the exact checked revised working curriculum
inputs: Exact final curriculum checked in s6
outputs: Saved revised document with actual approval status

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} assembly of actual chosen course fields and {LMS} material blocks, then a bounded prose draft from the teacher's actual revision decisions. Keep evidence evaluation, curriculum planning and complete final checking with the teacher before saving the final working document.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated course-field assembly and explanatory redrafting add handling to curriculum revision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native fields handle exact reuse; a bounded drafting loop can express already authored decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Representation, intellectual coherence and appropriate teaching methods require academic decisions.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher determines what students should learn and how the course should develop their understanding.

ambition.what: Reduce document handling around actual curriculum revision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document fields can reuse approved course blocks and bounded drafting can reword authored curriculum decisions subject to full teacher checking.

assumptions: Unmeasured curriculum-revision episode; shares are independent of the prompt prior.

Students and course systems produce actual evaluation records. s1 counts collection and verification; s2 and s3 count actual evaluation, planning and concrete change authorship. No finished curriculum or clean evaluation feed is assumed free.

s4 assembles actual chosen fields and approved blocks. Missing or inconsistent values require manual resolution. s5 cannot invent scholarly claims, readings or learning commitments; s6 checks the complete final document.

Use native assembly first; equivalent current reuse earns no extra gain. The saved document carries actual pending or approved status and is not a hidden course release. Any required curriculum approval occurs after the final version exists. Same-system saving earns no saving.
Gross 18 minus 3 upkeep gives 15 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Current material reuse and curriculum approval process
research_questions: Which course fields are re-entered during real revisions?

already_counted.description: Retained evidence review, revision decisions, prose editing and complete final checking

incremental.description: Maintain approved blocks and field mappings and check drafting against actual decisions

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete revised curriculum and actual approval status checked in s6; edits require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 15 assembly plus 3 prose-handling hours = 18 gross, minus 3 upkeep = 15 net.

tasks.short: Conduct cultural-studies research and publish findings

steps.what: Conduct the actual research, including source reading, authorized data collection and substantive coding
inputs: Actual research question and permitted sources
OTHER: existing qualitative research and reference-management workspace
outputs: Actual source-linked observations, coding decisions and research evidence

steps.what: Assemble the actual coded observations into the specified evidence tables with exact source identifiers
inputs: Explicit table fields and source-identifier mappings
outputs: Draft evidence tables and unmatched source fields

steps.what: Check evidence tables, interpret actual findings and write the scholarly argument and limitations
inputs: Draft evidence tables and unmatched fields
outputs: Authored findings and scholarly manuscript text

steps.what: Assemble the actual manuscript, verified references and author fields in the journal's required format
inputs: Actual journal format and author details
outputs: Complete draft publication package

steps.what: Check the complete final manuscript, tables, references, disclosures and actual submission destination
inputs: Actual journal instructions and author authority
outputs: Complete checked final submission package

steps.what: Submit the exact checked final manuscript package to the chosen professional journal
inputs: Exact final package and destination checked in s5
outputs: Submitted manuscript and actual submission receipt

tasks.design: Configure native evidence-table assembly in {OTHER} and {SPREADSHEET}, then exact manuscript-format assembly in {DOCS}. The teacher conducts the research, codes evidence, writes findings and checks the complete final package before the separate submission through {PARTNER_PORTAL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated evidence-table and publication-format handling adds effort around actual research and scholarly writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exports and document styles can assemble actual coded evidence and verified references without generating research claims.
tasks.still_hard: Source interpretation, cultural context, research ethics, substantive coding and defensible findings remain scholarly work.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher owns the interpretation and its relationship to actual evidence.

ambition.what: Reduce handling around actual research publication.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native qualitative-data exports and publication styles can assemble actual coded tables and references while leaving substantive research and interpretation with scholars.

assumptions: Unmeasured single-author qualitative research-to-journal episode, not a universal baseline for all research or publication types. Shares are independent of the prompt prior.

s1 counts actual design, source reading, authorized collection, capture and substantive coding. No free transcript, clean coded dataset or model-produced evidence is assumed. s2 only reformats actual coded records; missing source identifiers stop for manual resolution in s3.

s3 checks assembled tables and performs actual interpretation and findings authorship. s4 uses verified reference records, not generated citations. s5 checks the complete final package and actual disclosures.

This episode assumes actual delegated single-author submission authority. A multi-author or institutional approval must occur on the complete final package before submission and its labor must be added rather than assumed free. Editorial acceptance and final publication timing remain the journal's work, with no guaranteed acceptance claimed.

Use native exports and styles first; equivalent current assembly is baseline. s6 is a separate immediate gated send with no saving, not a hidden publication guarantee. Changed content or destination voids the gate. Gross 20 minus 4 upkeep gives 16 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Actual evidence-table handling and publication route
research_questions: Which evidence and reference fields are actually reformatted by hand?

already_counted.description: Retained actual research and source capture, interpretation, findings writing and complete final-package checking

incremental.description: Maintain evidence mappings and publication styles and verify changed source formats

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete manuscript package and journal destination checked in s5; changed content or destination requires renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional episode estimate: 15 evidence-table handling plus 5 format-assembly hours = 20 gross, minus 4 upkeep = 16 net. No reduction in research, coding, interpretation or scholarly argument is assumed.
